raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \varepsilon_ {a} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \varepsilon_ {a} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon_ {c} \end{array} \right)
$$

$\left( \varepsilon _ { a } > \varepsilon _ { c } \right)$ 微扰哈密顿量为

$$
\mathcal {H} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

由于 $2 \times 2$ 的 $w$ 矩阵在态基矢 $( 1 , 0 , 0 )$ 和 $( 0 , 1 , 0 )$ 上是对角的(实际上全为军)，可以假定它们是"好"态，但其实不是.为证明这一点，

(a) 求微扰哈密顿量' $\pmb { \mathcal { H } } = \pmb { \mathcal { H } } ^ { 0 } + \pmb { \mathcal { H } } ^ { \prime }$ '的精确本征值.   
(b) (a) 中的结果以 $| V |$ 为小量展开到二阶项.  
(c) 通过非简井微扰理论求三个态的能量(到二阶)，你能得到什么结果?如果上面关于"好"态的假设是正确的，这将是可行的.

理论上，如果 $w$ 矩阵的任一本征值都相等，那么对角化 矩阵的态不是唯的，对 $w$ 矩阵对角化并不能确定"好"态.当这种情况发生时(这并不少见)，你需要采用二阶筒并微扰理论(见习题 7.40).
raw_problem.solution_text:
a)

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} + \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \varepsilon_ {a} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \varepsilon_ {a} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon_ {c} \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \varepsilon_ {a} & 0 & V \\ 0 & \varepsilon_ {a} & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & \varepsilon_ {c} \end{array} \right).
$$

久期方程为

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c c} \varepsilon_ {a} - E & 0 & V \\ 0 & \varepsilon_ {a} - E & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & \varepsilon_ {c} - E \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

$$
\left(\varepsilon_ {a} - E\right) \left[ \left(\varepsilon_ {a} - E\right) \left(\varepsilon_ {c} - E\right) - 2 | V | ^ {2} \right] = 0,
$$

可得

$$
E _ {1} = \varepsilon_ {a},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} + \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \pm \sqrt {\frac {\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} + 2 | V | ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} + \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \pm \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \sqrt {1 + \frac {8 \left| V \right| ^ {2}}{\left(\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}\right) ^ {2}}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 由泰勒展开公式

$$
f (x) = \frac {f \left(x _ {0}\right)}{0 !} + \frac {f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right)}{1 !} \left(x - x _ {0}\right) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(x _ {0}\right)}{2 !} \left(x - x _ {0}\right) ^ {2} + \dots ,
$$

所以，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} + \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \pm \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \sqrt {1 + \frac {8 | V | ^ {2}}{(\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}) ^ {2}}} \\ \approx \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} + \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \pm \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \left[ 1 + \frac {4 | V | ^ {2}}{(\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}) ^ {2}} \right] \\ = \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} + \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} \pm \left[ \frac {\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}{2} + \frac {2 | V | ^ {2}}{\left(\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}\right)} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

因此， $E _ { 1 } = \varepsilon _ { a } , E _ { + } = \varepsilon _ { a } + \frac { 2 \left| V \right| ^ { 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { a } - \varepsilon _ { c } } , E _ { - } = \varepsilon _ { c } - \frac { 2 \left| V \right| ^ { 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { a } - \varepsilon _ { c } } .$ ê La - ê c. ê a - ê c

(c) 非简并微扰理论对应的三个量子态分别为 $\left( 1 , 0 , 0 \right) , \left( 0 , 1 , 0 \right)$ 和 $( 0 , 0 , 1 )$ ;

$$
E _ {1} \approx \varepsilon_ {a} + H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} + \sum_ {n \neq 1} \frac {| H _ {n 1} ^ {\prime} | ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {a} - E _ {n} ^ {0}},
$$

由

$$
H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = 0,
$$

$$
H _ {2 1} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = 0,
$$

$$
H _ {3 1} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = V ^ {*},
$$

可得

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {1} \approx \varepsilon_ {a} + 0 + \frac {\left| V \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}} \\ = \varepsilon_ {a} + \frac {\left| V \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同理，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {2} \approx \varepsilon_ {a} + H _ {2 2} ^ {\prime} + \sum_ {n \neq 2} \frac {\left| H _ {n 2} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {a} - E _ {n} ^ {0}} \\ = \varepsilon_ {a} + \frac {\left| V \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {3} \approx \varepsilon_ {c} + H _ {3 3} ^ {\prime} + \sum_ {n \neq 3} \frac {\left| H _ {n 3} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {c} - E _ {n} ^ {0}} \\ = \varepsilon_ {c} + 2 \frac {\left| V \right| ^ {2}}{\varepsilon_ {c} - \varepsilon_ {a}}. \\ \end{array}
$$
